candidates.task: README says edit STARTYEAR/ENDYEAR, then run bash download_source.sh; script downloads CMS HCRIS fiscal-year archives and extracts report, numeric and alpha files.
candidates.requirements: Bash, wget, unzip, network; account not indicated in inspected README. R and other dependencies apply for downstream processing, not download alone.
candidates.reference: Independently capture a permitted matching CMS fiscal-year release identity, checksums if offered, and archive contents; no reference material prepared.
candidates.caveats: Script deletes downloaded archives after extraction; it uses HTTP CMS links and default year range 1996–2024. Source availability, archive bytes, license, selected year, execution and limits unknown.
